pairs.subject: review-iteration-loops
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Document.tsx:196 A staged recalibration is accepted or discarded from a row that shows only its label, the re-run gate and the refusals. Neither the edit operations nor their per-edit `why` reach this surface, and VersionView has no field to carry them. So the creator accepts a revision without seeing what changed or why, and nothing lists the beats that were explicitly left unchanged.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Document.tsx:196 The engine in lib/script/editPlan.ts emits retime/rewrite/cut/insert, each with a `why`, and re-gates the staged version. The review surface that accepts the plan drops the operations and their whys, and the technique says an edit whose why the note's author cannot read is not finished.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Document.tsx:204 The engine's refusals show verbatim beside the staged version before it is accepted (refuse before apply). Accepting over a blocking gate is a separate act and stamps an override on the version (line 161).

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Document.tsx:73 Notes come from the closed NoteKind set: more-focus, less-focus, descope, move-earlier, move-later. The free-text `custom` escape hatch exists in the type but this surface filters it out (line 78), so a note outside the vocabulary has no entry here.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Notebook.tsx:103 Scope is set on its own surface, and a required card cannot be descoped there; its standing reason is shown (line 80). Cards that are descoped but still spoken in the Script are surfaced as a conflict chip (Document.tsx:189) rather than passed silently.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Notebook.tsx:137 `unanswered` is a terminal state, drawn in rose. Each result carries a verdict (strengthened, weakened, resolved or inconclusive) and typed effects shown as `${e.kind} ${e.target}` (line 147). The kinds include kills and downgrades (lib/research/followup.ts), and each effect is applied or rejected one by one.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Document.tsx:63 Card usage keeps the states spoken (with seconds), cut and unused apart, so a cut is not collapsed into absent. The seconds come from the server's split across the cards each beat states (lib/script/impact.ts splitAcross).

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Findings.tsx:37 These gate findings are anchored (at + quote) and are read by a human who decides. The technique says not to apply the fix-or-demote rule to a review a person reads directly.
app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Document.tsx:227 The editors here work on discrete text beats, which have no acoustic or visual seam, so the base edit-plan rules are complete for them.
